name: IPLocate.io API
tier_rationale: Terms and operator not reviewed by legal (P046 cond 1: every provider is terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal reviews it). Unknown tier: never default, excluded at AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN, IOC values only (A8).

reliability.justification: Reliability cannot be judged until the operator is reviewed (A8 unknown); one vote among >= 3 independent providers (P046 cond 6).

iplocate.description: IPLocate.io API key (optional: keyless lookups work at 50/day; the free key allows 1,000/day)
iplocate.plan_hint: unused until legal records IPLocate's terms (source iplocate.api is 'unknown', P046 cond 1)

api.title: IPLocate IP lookup (GET /api/lookup/{ip}: privacy.is_vpn/is_proxy/is_tor/is_hosting)

terms.quote: P046 cond 1 (binding council text): Every provider (VPNDetection, IPQuery, IPLocate, InternetData, ipapi.is, proxycheck.io) is terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal reviews it: disabled in every profile until legal records its terms (A1).

api.notes: Research C0107 (verified_live 200). Keyless answers carry x-ratelimit-limit: 50 (per day, reset 00:00 UTC, observed 2026-11-26); a free key raises it to 1,000/day. IPv6 answers are exploded (normalised before comparing). Used by ip_anonymizer_consensus.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P046). Quota block: the keyless 50/day seen in the x-ratelimit-limit header (2026-11-26); kept for keyed use too until the keyed plan is recorded.
